title: Mitosis non-stop shipping architecture (CI-to-green + blocked-MSP continuation)

completion_criteria.text: A dedicated Fable audit returns a flaw inventory of the current mitosis merge/PR-open gating with file:line citations, confirming or refuting the 7 findings from the 2026-07-27 review
Industry-standard research (merge queues, stacked PRs, CI auto-remediation, build-ahead schedulers) returns cited, verified findings
An improved architecture is specified that resolves the stop conditions and is demonstrably SIMPLER and MORE ROBUST than the current design, not merely more capable
The architecture specifies how mitosis drives a shipped MSP's CI/CD to green automatically (detect red, diagnose, fix, re-push, re-verify) with a bounded, non-looping failure path
The architecture specifies how mitosis continues into blocked MSPs while a parent PR is open for human review, without terminating the run
The user explicitly approves the architecture spec before any implementation begins

spine.active_goal: Replace the mitosis shipping architecture so a run never stops at a human review boundary: drive a shipped MSP's CI/CD to green automatically, then continue into blocked MSPs. Simpler and more robust, not merely more capable.
spine.next_step: Dispatch dedicated FABLE subagents IN PARALLEL: (a) AUDIT mitosis.js - confirm/refute the seven findings in the 2026-07-28 session log by file:line, and RUN the superpowers-parallel test suite (not run this session); (b) RESEARCH merge queues, stacked PRs under squash-merge, CI auto-remediation; (c) DESIGN - judged on mechanism REMOVED. User approval before implementing.
open_risks: Finding 5 is data-loss-class and live: park() cascades status 'parked' onto already-built dependents, and the common identical-spec relaunch cannot recover them despite the git checkpoint refs existing. Runs launched before the fix can silently discard frontier-built work.

Open design question: may a child PR open against base carrying its parents' commits (superset diff, violates the MSP green-branch invariant), or is deferral until parent-merge the only correct answer? Every proposal must answer this.

Open question: an auto-CI-to-green loop is an unbounded remediation loop aimed at a PUBLISHED branch. Needs a hard attempt bound, a no-force-push guarantee, and which failure classes are agent-fixable vs human-only - else it becomes the forbidden fragility.

Complexity ratchet: frontier-train, AIMD window, divergence probes, reconcile-only shepherd and saga compensation were each added to fix a stop condition and together produced today's fragility. A ninth mechanism should read as failing the constraint.
Findings are read-only inferences from a 4847-line file; the suite was never run. No proposal should build on them without the audit agent's independent confirmation.
out_of_scope: Any code change, commit, push, or PR this session - nothing was modified.
Merge policy itself: merges to any shared branch stay human-gated. The goal is non-stop AGENT progress, never agent-performed merges.
The other paused mitosis threads (frontier-default, preflight-hardening, resilience-implementation) and the blocked merge-boundary/SAST thread - do not fold their work in here.
Implementation of any fix, including the finding-5 data-loss bug, until the user approves an architecture spec.
